name: Armor Iron
base_description: dark riveted iron or steel armor with layered plate wear

name: Painted Plate
base_description: aged pale or dark painted armor plates with chipped edges
notes: Concept uses contrasting pale frontal platework against darker body.

name: Bone / Calcified Locomotion
base_description: ivory calcified load-bearing structures stained by mud and tissue
notes: Keep it structurally readable rather than generic skull texture.

name: Tendon and Sinew
base_description: fibrous red-brown tensile tissue bridging armor and locomotion

name: Exposed Flesh
base_description: dense muscular tissue visible through plate gaps
notes: Use restrained wetness variation to avoid plastic meat.

name: Vascular / Cable Detail
base_description: fine vessel and cable detail spanning biological and mechanical interfaces
notes: Prefer texture or curves unless silhouette needs geometry.

name: Ritual Relief
base_description: cast or bolted devotional portrait and insignia elements
notes: Can share armor material with selective patina.

name: Battlefield Accumulation
base_description: mud soot dust blood and trench residue
notes: Layered contamination rather than base material.

name: Scar / Repair Tissue
base_description: healed or active repair seams crossing flesh and plate interfaces
notes: Damage-state layer; should remain removable from clean variant.
